decision.summary: A sharp, multi-sample drop in U (≈−18 units) occurs at index 543, coinciding with a smaller E drop and continued N rise. U remains depressed through index 567, with only partial and delayed recovery starting at 568 (outside screened region). No clear opposing return is observed within allowed context [510,595]; the recovery is incomplete and asymmetric, so status is uncertain. The candidate jump at 551 aligns with onset but does not define interval boundaries; the true onset is earlier (543) based on original samples.
